mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} (process_code, owned_enterprise_code, process_run_code, apply_staff_code, next_code, transfer_info, process_step_info, process_form_info, process_status, table_primary_key_list) VALUES (#{processModel.processCode}, #{processModel.ownedEnterpriseCode}, #{processModel.processRunCode}, #{processModel.applyStaffCode}, #{processModel.nextCode}, #{processModel.transferInfo}, #{processModel.processStepInfo}, #{processModel.processFormInfo}, #{processModel.processStatus}, #{processModel.tablePrimaryKeyList}) ON CONFLICT (process_code) DO UPDATE SET process_status = EXCLUDED.process_status, next_code = EXCLUDED.next_code
mapper.select: SELECT process_code, owned_enterprise_code, process_run_code, table_primary_key_list::BIGINT[], apply_staff_code, next_code, transfer_info, process_step_info, process_form_info, process_status, create_time, update_time, delete_flag FROM ${tableName} WHERE delete_flag = false AND process_code = #{processCode}
